description: Turn-based tactical roguelite with squad action points, cover, line of sight, status effects, enemy turns, loot, permadeath and multi-room progression.

requirements.text: Movement and attacks consume action points and fail when unaffordable.
requirements.check: Movement and attacks consume action points and fail when unaffordable.

requirements.text: Cover reduces incoming damage only when it blocks the attack line.
requirements.check: Cover reduces incoming damage only when it blocks the attack line.

requirements.text: Opaque obstacles block direct line-of-sight attacks.
requirements.check: Opaque obstacles block direct line-of-sight attacks.

requirements.text: Status effects apply and expire after their configured duration.
requirements.check: Status effects apply and expire after their configured duration.

requirements.text: Enemy phase starts after player squad ends turn and enemies act once.
requirements.check: Enemy phase starts after player squad ends turn and enemies act once.

requirements.text: Dead squad members remain unavailable for the run unless revival is supported.

requirements.text: Next room loads only after required enemies are defeated.
